title: DOC
description: DOC is a UX-focused medical centre website designed to make healthcare information clear and easy to access. The interface prioritises simplicity, accessibility, and trust, and was built using React and shadcn/ui.

title: World explorer
description: World Explorer is a React web application designed to make country information easy to explore and understand. The interface focuses on usability and clarity, allowing users to view key details about each country through a simple and intuitive experience.
